title: Emarginate
summary: EM'ARGINATE EM'ARGINATED, adjective [Latin margo, whence emargino.] 1. In botany, notched at the end; applied to the leaf, corol or stigma. 2. In mineralogy, having all the edges of the primitive form

inlines.v: EM'ARGINATE EM'ARGINATED, adjective [Latin margo, whence emargino.] 1. In botany, notched at the end; applied to the leaf, corol or stigma. 2. In mineralogy, having all the edges of the primitive form truncated, each by one face.
